title: The King Begins Adventuring
overview: Arthur has been adventuring with Jasmine under the alias of Note, and they have a dangerous encounter.

title: The Princess Begins Adventuring
overview: Tessia has a mission to promote harmony between the races as an adventurer, and things aren't going smoothly.

title: The King Is Stranded
overview: Arthur, Elijah, and Lucas find themselves on a deserted island, so they try to find a way back home.

title: The King's Homecoming
overview: With quests at a standstill due to the recent mana beast issues, Arthur spends some time at home.

title: The King's Struggles
overview: Arthur and Jasmine are recruited for a dungeon raid that ends up being more dangerous than it seemed.

title: The King Is Betrayed
overview: In the lowest level of the dungeon, Arthur and his party have a horrifying encounter.

title: The King Survives
overview: An unexpected ability helps Elijah save Arthur's life, as they try to find a way out of the dungeon.

title: The King's Day in Court
overview: Note faces an inquiry at the Guild, while Lucas schemes to avoid responsibility for his betrayal.

title: The King's Gratitude
overview: Having returned home with Elijah, Arthur prepares for school at the academy and bids Jasmine farewell.

title: The King Negotiates
overview: Arthur seeks a gift to give Eleanor for her birthday, and has an interesting encounter as a result.

title: The King Celebrates
overview: It's Eleanor's birthday, and Arthur has a special gift for his little sister.

title: The King Enrolls
overview: Before enrolling in Xyrus Academy, Arthur faces the person responsible for his disastrous dungeon raid.
